steps.name: Multi-exhibit species narrows exhibit list
steps.do: Leave **Exhibit** empty. In **Species**, type **Cheetah** and select it from the suggestions.
steps.expect: The exhibit list is limited to **Africa Savanna** and **Indo-Malaya Outdoor**. **Exhibit** stays unselected (the form does not pick one).

steps.name: Unique species fills exhibit
steps.do: In **Species**, type **African Lion** and select it from the suggestions.
steps.expect: **African Lion** stays selected. **Exhibit** fills with **Africa Savanna**.

steps.name: Single enclosure hides scope
steps.do: Look at **Viewing scope** after **African Lion** is selected.
steps.expect: **Viewing scope** is not shown. The card height does not change. Save still applies to the unnamed enclosure.

steps.name: Date range + reason
steps.do: Leave **Start date** blank. Leave **Last day** blank. In **Reason**, enter a short note (e.g. **Manual test off display**).
steps.expect: Form is ready to save (blank **Start date** starts immediately; blank **Last day** stays off display until set on display).

steps.name: Submit off display
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** was set as off display.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. Leave **Include off display animals** unchecked.

steps.name: Map with include
steps.expect: **African Lion** marker appears; click it and the off-display message is shown.

steps.name: Itinerary confirm
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Build for today, enable **Include off-display animals**, and try adding **African Lion**.

steps.name: Set on display
steps.do: In Console, open **Set animal as on display**. Leave **Exhibit** empty. In **Species**, type **African Lion** and select it from the suggestions.
steps.expect: Exhibit options include **Africa Savanna** because it has an off-display animal. Suggestions include **African Lion** because it is off display now. Choosing **African Lion** fills **Exhibit** with **Africa Savanna**. **Viewing scope** stays hidden because there is only one enclosure.

steps.name: Submit on display
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** was set as on display.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: From the bottom nav, return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Include off display animals** unchecked.
steps.expect: **African Lion** shows as a normal on-display marker again.
